_comment: API proxy — MUST be the first rule (Amplify evaluates in order, first match wins). Routes /api/newsroom/* transparently to the deployed API Gateway HTTP API, so the browser/admin UI keep calling relative /api/newsroom/... exactly as they do today — no frontend URL/CORS changes needed. Replace <api-id> with the real API Gateway HTTP API id once it's deployed (see aws/template.yaml's Outputs.ApiEndpoint).

Amplify's own standard Single Page App rewrite (this is Amplify's documented default preset, not a custom regex invented for this project). Applies ONLY when no real file exists at the requested path — Amplify, like Vercel, serves an exact filesystem match first (this is what lets the prerendered dist/newsroom/<slug>/index.html shells keep working: a request for /newsroom/<slug> resolves to that real file before this rule is ever evaluated). Only truly unknown paths fall through to index.html for client-side React Router to handle.
